settings.rm_help_definition: 1RM is the maximum weight for one repetition. The app estimates it from the weight and reps in a set. 10RM estimates the corresponding weight for ten reps, helping you compare sets with different weights and rep counts.
settings.rm_help_choice: Unsure? Keep Epley, the default formula. The formulas give different estimates; keeping the same formula helps you compare workouts consistently.
settings.rm_description_epley: 1RM = weight × (1 + reps / 30). The estimate increases linearly with repetitions.
settings.rm_description_brzycki: 1RM = weight × 36 / (37 − reps). Repetitions affect the denominator, so the estimate increases faster as the rep count rises.
settings.rm_description_lander: 1RM = 100 × weight / (101.3 − 2.67123 × reps). Another denominator-based formula, with different coefficients from Brzycki.
settings.rm_description_oconner: 1RM = weight × (1 + 0.025 × reps). A linear formula that increases more slowly than Epley for multiple repetitions.
settings.rm_description_lombardi: 1RM = weight × reps^0.10. The relationship uses a power instead of a linear increase.
settings.rm_help_10rm: To calculate 10RM, the app first estimates 1RM, then inverts the same formula for ten reps. A set of 10 reps at 20 kg therefore corresponds to an estimated 10RM of 20 kg.
settings.rm_help_limits: These are estimates and also depend on actual effort. An easy set may underestimate your capacity. With no external load or with variable-resistance bands, the workout shows “—”. Weights keep the convention you enter, for example per dumbbell.
settings.session_automatic: The program and engine determine sets, rest times, progression and lighter weeks. Warm-up instructions are available for each exercise. Equipment alerts are triggered automatically from your inventory and performance.
settings.rpe_help: Rate how difficult each set feels from 6 to 10. This helps the engine identify very demanding workouts.
settings.vibration_help: Available on devices and browsers that support vibration.
settings.advisor_optional: Optional AI coach setup. Program creation and progression work without AI.
settings.advanced_help: The RM formula helps compare performance. Network settings control access to the app. You can keep their current values.
planner.unlimited_help: With unlimited duration, keep your program as long as you want. Progression and weekly reviews continue.
